answer_1.quote: We evaluate our model on two open story generation datasets, WritingPrompts and Wikiplots.

answer_2.quote: We adopt the following automatic metrics to evaluate the generated stories in terms of (1) relevance, (2) diversity and (3) repetition. (1-a) BLEU ... (2-a) reverse-BLEU ... (2-b) Distinct ... (3) Token Repetition ...

answer_4.quote: We hired three annotators from Amazon Mechanical Turk to give a preference (win, lose, or tie) in terms of coherence and diversity independently.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to choose win/lose/tie based on the story's coherence (stays on topic, logical structure) and informativeness/diversity.
